title: Affine-over-base inclusion preserves directed inverse limits
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $J$ a nonempty directed preorder. Let $F:J^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Aff}/S$ be a diagram in the full subcategory of schemes over $S$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] whose structure morphisms are affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If $c$ is a limiting cone in this full subcategory, then its image under the inclusion $\mathrm{Aff}/S\to\mathrm{Sch}/S$ is a limiting cone in all schemes over $S$.

source.place: Tag 01YX (lemma-directed-inverse-system-has-limit), local universal-property argument in its proof, with Tag 01YW (lemma-directed-inverse-system-affine-schemes-has-limit)

proof.text: Send the given limiting cone through the relative-spectrum anti-equivalence E to a colimit cocone of quasi-coherent algebras. The directed algebra-colimit theorem provides an ambient algebra-sheaf colimit with quasi-coherent vertex. The full-subcategory inclusion creates this colimit and hence preserves the colimit cocone supplied by E.

Construct the contravariant structure-algebra functor K on all of Over S by f maps to f_* O_X, with section maps h.appLE. The object and morphism clauses for E give a natural isomorphism from E followed by the algebra inclusion to the affine-over inclusion followed contravariantly by K. Transport the preceding colimit along that isomorphism.

For any test scheme X over S and an affine Y over S, prove that K induces a bijection Hom_S(X,Y) to Hom_Alg(K(Y),K(X)). Injectivity is checked on inverse images of affine base opens using the Gamma-Spec adjunction. For surjectivity apply affine_algebra_local_maps to obtain compatible maps, glue them over the inverse-image cover of X, prove the glued map is over S by cover extensionality, and identify its algebra map on the affine basis.

An arbitrary cone in Over S gives an algebra cocone by K. Its unique algebra-colimit factorization corresponds through the Hom bijection to a map into the original cone vertex. Contravariant functoriality and injectivity at each affine stage prove every projection identity. Injectivity at the affine cone vertex and uniqueness of the algebra-colimit factorization prove uniqueness of this map.

proof_origin.place: E2 proof via the structure-algebra Hom bijection and ambient directed colimits; Stacks 01YX, 01SA and 01LT. Local gluing adapts the proved private helper of AffineStructureAlgebraFullyFaithful; injectivity proves local extensionality directly without duplicating affine_over_ext.
